g.title: enable
g.text: Explicit jev enable: validate key then owner-only credential + config
Claude/Codex host adapter suppresses legacy retrieval when enabled

g.title: context
g.text: Throughline public context: completed last3 turns, 1.5s guard
completed turn text sent to Jev API; not persisted by Caveat

g.title: score
g.text: Fixed jev-1.13.0: repeated problem AND clearly stuck >= .8
choose at most3 search terms above none probability

g.title: none
g.text: Disabled / missing context / no new turn / not struggling

g.title: error
g.text: not a fabricated no-match or delivered result

g.title: state
g.text: jevObservations owns private outcome / cursor / term / delivery state
turn IDs and decisions, not raw conversation text

g.title: review
g.text: CLI cases / review and Web Jev view
show denominator / reasons / delivery / owner judgment

g.title: fts
g.text: Local SQLite AND FTS, at most20 candidates
finally close search DB BEFORE relevance API call
candidate excerpts sent to Jev; >= .8 selects reference

g.title: generic
g.text: if same term already delivered -> suppressed

g.title: prepare
g.text: construct proposed context for host adapter
no delivery count or markHit at mere selection

g.title: output
g.text: delivered records terms for generic or matched reminder
selected reference only: separate markHit DB, finally closes
